body.prompt: The woman in the reference images, the same face throughout, tied-back hair, mint fleece, black leggings. She stands in profile with arms raised overhead in a gentle backbend, lowers the joined hands slowly to her chest and turns to face the camera, ending in Praṇāmāsana, palms together at the chest, looking calmly at the viewer, a soft smile. One calm exhale. Fixed camera, eye level, full body in frame, feet on the same ground line. A soft dawn sky behind her: deep indigo above fading through dusty rose into a warm ochre haze at the ground line, no clouds, no buildings, first light. Photoreal, her face identical to the references, calm editorial pacing.
